spl_product_data_elements: MediChoice Povidone-Iodine Prep Pad POVIDONE-IODINE WATER GLYCERIN CITRIC ACID MONOHYDRATE SODIUM HYDROXIDE POVIDONE-IODINE IODINE
spl_unclassified_section: Other information 1% titratable iodine For hospital or professional use only.
active_ingredient: Active ingredient Povidone-iodine USP 10% Purpose Antiseptic
warnings: Warnings For external use only. Do not use if allergic to iodine Ask a doctor before use if injuries are deep wounds, puncture wounds, or serious burn Stop use and ask a doctor if infection occurs or if redness, irritation, swelling or pain persists or increases Keep out of reach of children. In case of accidental ingestion, seek professional assistance or consult a poison control center Immediately Avoid excessive heat. Store at room temperature.
